rationale: Denial code ranking changed to quantify_missing=by_status to show breakdown of missing denial codes by claim status (Adjusted, Denied, Paid, Pended). Denial rate by segment retained with segments across all five requested dimensions and denominator set to adjudicated_claims with min_group_size=30 to flag unstable segments. Report parameters updated: show_denominators set to true to print every rate as numerator/denominator=rate, and small_groups caveat added to document instability of small segments.
changes_summary: Changed denial_code_ranking quantify_missing from 'overall' to 'by_status' to break down missing denial codes by claim status. Updated write_report to set show_denominators=true (printing numerator/denominator=rate for all rates) and added 'small_groups' caveat to document that rates for segments with fewer than 30 claims are unstable. These changes address completeness and communication feedback.
